task.text:
(20 points) The time that customers wait to be served at the delicatessen for a grocery store follows the uniform distribution between 0 and 10 minutes. What is the probability that a randomly selected customer will wait more than 7 minutes at the deli?
 
(Answer)
Probability that the customer wait more than 7 minutes = ( % )
